scope: Independent read-only source, memory, containment and saved-CPU-evidence review. No mesh processing, model/native imports, GPU/WSL execution, tests, source edits or Git mutation by reviewer.

execution_route.entry: Existing amd_generation_mesh.py CLI via runpy, with explicit saved source/hash/run-contract and fresh private mesh leaf.
execution_route.source_arithmetic: Unchanged original CPU translation: sigmoid dual vertices, strict flags, F32 softplus/product split/tie rule, global original indices, grid512/AABB transform, vertex order and winding. Pinned original semantics reviewed in preliminary receipt.
execution_route.gate: Exact GO plus EOF is required before the CPU audit guard and NumPy/CLI processing. Parent applies existing OwnedJob/ExtendedLimits then attaches child before GO; no breakaway.
execution_route.forbidden: Torch/Triton/FlexGEMM/O-Voxel/Trellis/CuPy and other listed AI/native imports; child process and network operations are denied before actual CLI execution.
execution_route.memory_cap_scope: Existing Windows per-process committed-memory cap; file-backed working set is separately observed, not bounded by this counter. One child with further process creation denied.
execution_route.cleanup: Up to 5seconds natural Job settlement, then bounded owned Job cleanup if needed; no blanket process/WSL operation. Peak working-set/pagefile/private counters and Job process/aggregate committed peaks are recorded. Cleanup bookkeeping is outside the 180-second child-work bound.
execution_route.exclusive: Absent private output leaf and exclusive extraction-run directory/marker/logs prevent automatic retry; preserve partial evidence on any failure.

resource_basis.projection_scope: Conservative all-phase source-array overcount and explicit scratch allowances from preliminary receipt; not a measured process peak or library-allocator guarantee. The 6GiB cap plus live RAM/disk gates remain actual guards.
resource_basis.integer_scope: Maximum vertex index 1957890 and grid key 134217727 fit existing indices; optional duplicate-face key maximum 7505256340959698970 fits signed 64-bit.

saved_CPU_checks.execution_attribution: Root ran the saved checks; reviewer read the actual logs and source without rerunning.
saved_CPU_checks.covered: Actual owned GO-gated fixture denied Torch import, process and network; measured Windows working-set and Job-commit APIs; natural Job release; bad/extra/missing GO tokens; threshold equality and just-below resource denial; canonical converter arithmetic/winding/tie/global/boundary behavior and strict source-reader negatives.

limits: This is clearance for one extraction only. Separate verify_mesh.py remains subject to its own review before verification; extraction does not depend on its incomplete review.
Actual CLI verifies PLY readback exactly and saves/hashes NPY files; full NPY reopening and independent source/quad/triangle diagnostics require the separately bounded verifier.
Any source-generated zero-area triangle causes fail-closed extraction before output acceptance; do not remove or repair triangles, change arithmetic or retry.

Actual mesh triangle count, memory peak, topology and visual fidelity remain unmeasured. A completed extraction must have source unchanged, complete outputs, successful readback and natural cleanup before any PASS claim.
No model forward, GPU/WSL work, textures/materials, GLB conversion or frontend work is covered.
decision: No known prelaunch blocker in the exact contained extraction route. Root retains execution control; stop on any unchanged identity/resource/deadline/numerical/cleanup guard and do not retry.
